english: Old Lady Clary was the last bride of House Ansilla... and insane. They say she spoke to spirits, and that she smothered her own infant child.

chinese: 克莱里老夫人是安西拉家族最后的新娘……然后发疯了。他们说她和鬼魂对话，而且闷死了她自己年幼的孩子。

english: I was hired to take the note from him, sure as rain. A gnomish scholar named Airancourt hired me to take it, and throw it in the Quarry.
